headline: Recommended denying Wildwood Ave. and Orient St. sidewalk petitions; recommended approving 360 May St. sidewalk and Lovell St. sidewalk repairs.
summary: Members recommended denying the Wildwood Ave. petition and two Orient St. sidewalk petitions, each by a 3-0 vote. They recommended approving a new sidewalk at 360 May St., sidewalk repairs, street resurfacing, and signage requests. Several other petitions were recommended for leave to withdraw or filing.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 30, 2026 meeting, 3-0.
Recommended denying the petition to make Wildwood Ave. from Apricot St. to 301 Wildwood Ave. public, 3-0.
Recommended denying the petition for new sidewalks on the upper portion of Orient St., 3-0.
Recommended denying the petition for a new sidewalk on Orient St. from Sultan St. to Plantation St., 3-0.
Recommended approving about 220 feet of sidewalk construction in front of 360 May St., 3-0.
Recommended granting leave to withdraw the petition for a new sidewalk on Heard St., 3-0.
Recommended adding 15 Coombs Rd. to the Sidewalk Repair List, 3-0.
Recommended adding 5 Coombs Rd. to the Sidewalk Repair List, 3-0.
Recommended adding the odd side of Lovell St. from Columbus St. to Garland St. to the Sidewalk Repair List, 3-0.
Recommended granting leave to withdraw the petition for sidewalk repair in front of 29 to 31 Laconia Rd., 3-0.
Recommended granting leave to withdraw the petition for street resurfacing on Sagamore Rd. near 53 Sagamore Rd., 3-0.
Recommended placing Mellor Ave. on the Street Resurfacing List, 3-0.
Recommended granting leave to withdraw the request to resurface First St., 3-0.
Recommended adding Doris St. to the Street Resurfacing List, 3-0.
Recommended adding East Central St. to the Street Resurfacing List, 3-0.
Recommended adding North Pkwy. to the Street Resurfacing List, 3-0.
Recommended granting leave to withdraw the request for street resurfacing in front of 31 Laconia Rd., 3-0.
Recommended placing the petition to ban lift kits on city-owned trucks on file, 3-0.
Recommended approving No Littering signage on North St. along the property line of Rural Cemetery and Crematory, 3-0.
Recommended approving No Dumping signage with fine amounts at the end of Chatanika Ave. where it borders Cascade Park, 3-0.
